info.name: Slaras Nusa Foodlab API
info.description:
# Slaras Nusa Foodlab API

Laravel 11 REST API for the Slaras Nusa Foodlab ERP. All endpoints are served under `/api`.

## Base URL
`{{baseURL}}` defaults to `http://localhost:8080` — the docker nginx port follows
`BACKEND_HTTP_PORT`. Every request path already includes `/api`.

## Authentication
Sanctum personal access tokens (`Authorization: Bearer {{bearerToken}}`).

1. Run **Auth > Login** (`admin@foodlab.test` / `password` with the default seeder).
2. The test script saves `data.token` into `bearerToken`.
3. Every other request inherits the collection auth.

Public endpoints: `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, `GET /api/health`, `GET /api/metrics`.

## Active company
`GET/POST /api/v1/active-company` selects the global company. The selection can be overridden
per request with the `X-Active-Company-Id` header (available as a disabled header on list
requests) and is used by `?active_company=1` list scoping.

## List convention
Every index endpoint supports:

- `filter[<field>]=value` — flat aliases such as `?search=` / `?company_id=` still work
- `sort=field` / `sort=-field`
- `include=relation` (camelCase relations; `...Count` / `...Exists` variants are available too)
- `active_company=1` on company-scoped lists
- `page` + `per_page` — without them the full filtered list is returned (cached 60 s);
  `per_page` is capped at **100**

## Writes
- `POST` / `PUT` / `PATCH` / `DELETE` run in DB transactions; deletes are soft deletes.
- `PATCH` is a real partial update (`sometimes` rules): send only the changed fields.
- Optional `Idempotency-Key` header on POST: the same key + payload within 300 s replays the
  cached 2xx response (`X-Idempotency-Replayed: true`); a different payload returns `422`.
- Duplicate active records (DB-level race) surface as `422` with `errors.duplicate`.

## Responses
- Single resource: `{ "data": { ... } }`
- List: `{ "data": [ ... ], "meta": { "count", "total", "page", "per_page", "last_page", ... } }`
- Delete: `{ "message": "..." }`
- Validation failure: `422` with `{ "message", "errors": { field: [...] } }`
- Missing/invalid token: `401` with `{ "message": "Unauthenticated." }`

## Modules
| Module | Overview | Resources |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CFO (Keuangan) | `GET /api/v1/modules/cfo` | companies, capital-companies, company-assets, expense-categories, expense-types, expense-items |
| CHO (SDM) | `GET /api/v1/modules/cho` (+ `/enums`) | employee-positions, employment-statuses, payroll-grades, tax-statuses, employees, payroll-runs, payroll-items |
| CPO | `GET /api/v1/modules/cpo` | overview only |
| CDO | `GET /api/v1/modules/cdo` | overview only |
| CMO | `GET /api/v1/modules/cmo` | overview only |
| HR | — (no overview) | employee-shifts, employee-shift-assignments, employee-attendances (+ `/scan`) |

`GET /api/v1/modules` aggregates the five launcher modules (HR is not included).

Other endpoints: `GET/POST /api/v1/samples`, `GET /api/v1/samples/{id}`,
`POST /api/v1/documents`, `POST /api/v1/modules/cho/employees/upload-document`.

## Notes
- All writes invalidate the related list caches (and the active-company cache where relevant).
- Interactive OpenAPI docs are generated by Scramble at `/docs/api` (`/docs/api.json`).

request.description:
`POST /api/v1/modules/cfo/companies` — creates a company.

Required: `name`.

`name` + `series` must be unique (case-insensitive) among active companies. Deleting a company soft-deletes its children across CFO, CHO and HR, and clears the active-company cache.
